comment_regular: Verified (Oblivion): pass-level binder applies the active NiD3DPass PixelConstantMap and VertexConstantMap after binding its shader programs. The ShadowLightShader pixel/vertex maps are then applied by NiD3DShader_SetupShaderPrograms, so texture-effect constants flow through shader-owned maps after any pass-owned map entries.
